product_metadata.title: Household Essentials Polyester Mesh Sweater Wash Bag, 18 by 22-Inch
features: Eliminates the need for separate washing cycles as bag protects valuable
description: Extend the life of your sweaters and other machine-washable clothing items with this durable and protective mesh wash bag. Say goodbye to tedious handwashing or single item laundry loads that can run up your water bill in a hurry! Simply drop your sweater or other garment inside the bag, zip it up with the attached nylon zipper and run the suggested wash cycle with the rest of your laundry as necessary. The mesh design allows more delicate clothing to be washed thoroughly and completely without the risk of tangling, twisting or snagging. This will not only extend the life of your favorite clothing, but also help it maintain its original shape. Measuring 18 inches by 22 inches, the mesh bag is the perfect size for sweaters, lingerie, delicates, bathing suits and anything else susceptible to irritating snags and tangles. As always, it is suggested to adhere to your items’ washing recommendations at all times. The mesh laundry bag also serves as a handy and safe solution for socks, gloves, scarves, face masks or other loose items prone to vanishing throughout the wash cycle. The wash bag is made from a strong yet soft white polyester mesh and is secured by a pink nylon zipper which stays securely fastened on even the fastest washing or drying cycles..
